reviews.text: We had a major pool problem and we called around and got several quotes for the needed repairs. All were extremely expensive but we found North Texas Pool Remodeling for help and they came through for us in a big way. The quote they gave us was lower than others we had received and it was well detailed.  Monte was great to work with and he was very helpful, informative and attentive to the job site. His crews he had working on our pool we all very friendly and prompt. Monte was there every day t

We highly recommend North Texas Pool Remodeling.  Monty Davis and his crew did an excellent job in replacing all the tile and replastering our 40+ year old pool.  It looks brand new and we love it.  He is very honest, very dependable and arrived when he said they would.  He kept us informed of exactly what was happening,  what to expect and his price was very reasonable.  We couldn't be happier.
Monty's crew did great work!  Replaced the tile in our pool in one day.  Reasonable price.  Quality work.  No mess.  Would highly recommend North Texas Pool Remodeling!

I have used North Texas Pool Remodeling twice now throughout the years and am always impressed with their service and finished product. I would highly recommend them to anyone who has a small or large project. We started with a small project a few years back that they did.  We just recently had a large scale remodel done and we couldn't be happier! The finished product is beautiful and they were a great company to work with!

As a former construction business owner, I appreciated the detail and on the job supervision and communication that Monty Davis provides to his projects. The remodel exceeded our expectations and we would highly recommend his company!

I have used North Texas Pool Remodeling to acid wash my pool. It was bad performance some ever done it for me. He did not clean the pool all. I had to call another contactor to do acid wash my pool again. I am not  impressed with their service and finished product. I would not recommend them to anyone who has a small or large project.
I was very impressed with this pool company. They replaced the tile on my hot tub and it looks awesome!!  I highly recommend them. And if I need future work on my pool I will definitely call on them
Never contacted me or followed up
Great person Great service!

He is very honest, very dependable and arrived when he said they would.  He kept us informed of exactly what was happening,  what to expect and his price was very reasonable.  We couldn't be happier.

As a former construction business owner, I appreciated the detail and on the job supervision and communication that Monty Davis provides to his projects. The remodel exceeded our expectations and we would highly recommend his company!

data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. The local Google reviews appear overly positive and potentially curated, while the HQ Google reviews present a more balanced picture with specific positive and negative experiences. The business has been operating for 36 years, which lends some credibility, but the perfect local rating with no negative feedback is suspicious.
fake_signals: Local Google reviews are all 5-star with no negative feedback
Some reviews are very old (8-9 years)
Local reviews mention different primary contacts (David, Ashley, Chad) over time

negative_evidence: Negative review mentions having to call another contractor to redo acid wash work

authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (pool heater repair, tile replacement, acid wash)
Positive reviews mention crew names and specific helpful actions
data.discrepancy_explanation: The local Google listing has a perfect 5.0 rating from 8 reviews, while the HQ listing has a 4.2 with 2 negative reviews. This suggests the local listing may be curated or less representative of the full customer experience.
